tasks.label: Run chatbot audit harness
tasks.command: npx tsc --module ES2020 --target ES2020 --outDir .tmp-audit chatbot-audit.ts src/components/chatbot/chatKnowledge.ts && node .tmp-audit/chatbot-audit.js

tasks.label: Audit chatbot with ES module TS
tasks.command: npx tsc --module es2020 --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --outDir .tmp-audit chatbot-audit.ts src/components/chatbot/chatKnowledge.ts && node .tmp-audit/chatbot-audit.js

tasks.label: Audit chatbot routing
tasks.command: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --pretty false --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --outDir .tmp-audit chatbot-audit.ts && node .tmp-audit/chatbot-audit.js

tasks.label: Run full chatbot audit
tasks.command: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --pretty false --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --outDir .tmp-audit chatbot-audit.ts && node .tmp-audit/chatbot-audit.js

tasks.label: Full audit + build verification
tasks.command: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --pretty false --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --outDir .tmp-audit chatbot-audit.ts && node .tmp-audit/chatbot-audit.js && npm run build

tasks.label: Final audit and build check
tasks.command: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --pretty false --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --outDir .tmp-audit chatbot-audit.ts && node .tmp-audit/chatbot-audit.js && npm run build
